info.title: AI Platform Task Commands and Outcomes
info.description: Vertical Slice 01 Event Bus contracts: task-commands and task-outcomes channels. See docs/implementation/vertical-slice-01.md Section 10. Contract only in Sprint 1 — no Event Bus adapter exists yet.

local-redpanda.description: Local-development Redpanda broker (ADR-0005). Not a production topology.

task-commands.description: Orchestrator -> selected Test Agent deployment. Keyed by workflow_id; ordering exists only within (channel, workflow_id).

task-outcomes.description: Test Agent -> Orchestrator. Keyed by workflow_id; ordering exists only within (channel, workflow_id).

publishExecuteTask.summary: Orchestrator publishes ExecuteTask after the submission transaction commits.

consumeExecuteTask.summary: The selected Test Agent deployment receives and validates ExecuteTask.

publishTaskOutcome.summary: The Test Agent publishes TaskCompleted or TaskFailed after its outcome transaction commits.

consumeTaskOutcome.summary: The Orchestrator receives and validates the terminal event.

ExecuteTask.name: ExecuteTask
ExecuteTask.title: ExecuteTask
ExecuteTask.summary: Command: execute the deterministic text.word-count capability for one task attempt.

TaskCompleted.name: TaskCompleted
TaskCompleted.title: TaskCompleted
TaskCompleted.summary: Event: the Test Agent completed the task attempt successfully.

TaskFailed.name: TaskFailed
TaskFailed.title: TaskFailed
TaskFailed.summary: Event: the Test Agent's task attempt failed with a safe, stable failure code.
